title: Library Stacks
shortDescription: Tall shelves shelter the papery hush of a thousand journeys.
longDescription:
Oak shelves lean around the room's living branches, their ladders sliding on brass rails. Cloth bookmarks hang from open volumes like bright tongues, and a little clock ticks much more quietly than seems mechanically reasonable.
Librarian Quill sorts a stack of field guides beneath a green-shaded lamp. One book lies open beside the borrowing register, with an awkward gap between its pages.

fixtures.name: Librarian Quill
fixtures.lookDescription: A tawny owl balancing spectacles, three bookmarks, and considerable patience. Try talk quill.
fixtures.examineDescription: Quill wears half-moon spectacles on a ribbon and a waistcoat with pockets exactly the size of library cards. A feather behind one ear is labelled 'Not a pen'. Her sternest expression is reserved for folded page corners.
fixtures.dialogue: "Books may travel. Their pages should generally travel together." Quill closes a field guide with one finger marking a gap. "If something has gone astray, we begin by finding out what happened. Blame is a poor bookmark."

fixtures.name: Borrowing Register
fixtures.examineDescription: Beside 'A Small Guide to Remarkable Woodland Birds', the register reads: 'Missing: the page about the lantern wren. Last copied in the Scriptorium; last heard about in the Music Loft.' Quill has added: 'Mistakes may be mended. Please bring explanations, not accusations.'
